strats.name: Example: Ritual for omens
strats.author: StashOfExile2
strats.summary: An example of the layout: run maps with Ritual, save tribute, buy the omens that sell well. Numbers left out on purpose - add real ones from your runs.
requirements: A build that clears Ritual circles safely
steps: Do every Ritual circle in the map
Defer favours you don't want so they come back cheaper
Buy the omens worth the most on the Currency Exchange (Settings > Exchange rates)
tips: Track a few runs with the Run tracker to get your own profit per hour
risks: Omen prices move a lot in the first weeks of a league

oneliners.text: Perfect Trans + Perfect Aug all white ilvl 80+ bases, look for 2 good mods worth something, then price and list it.
oneliners.author: StashOfExile2
